svg.title: MoraWorld Renderer architecture
svg.desc: The first RGB frame and text prompt, together with a choice of robot-only, robot-and-object or full-scene white clay or an Action Map, are encoded into a shared token sequence with noisy video and silent audio. Recorded actions modulate the H3 transformer with AdaLN. Camera poses and intrinsics enter self-attention through PRoPE. A flow sampler refines the video latents and the video VAE decodes RGB. This recipe mixes nine single-view Action Map updates with one multiview robot-and-objects clay update.
svg.text: From proxy geometry to RGB video
An action-conditioned H3 world model for single-view and synchronized multiview generation.
One visual reference type per sample
Action MLP → AdaLN in both sublayers
Video VAE + patchify · 2 Hz reference grid
9 single-view Action Map steps per 1 three-view robot + objects clay step
Updates Action AdaLN and camera LoRA
